title: Red Stitch
personality:
Malgrave's royal seamstress, who stitched the fallen into the court's Relics. She deserted and now hunts Malgrave's loyalists, leaving a red-threaded needle at every kill.
Her own shadow came loose when she stitched her first Relic; it's only a wrong-looking shadow, not a pet.
fantasy: The hunter of high ground. Climbs, reads the field, pins people to walls.
silhouette: the long weapon over the shoulder

card.loop: Ranged marksman: time each bow draw, pin foes to walls with Heavy Shots, and watch hurt rivals through cover.
card.role: Ranged marksman: time each bow draw, pin foes to walls with Heavy Shots, and watch hurt rivals through cover.
card.lmb: Hold to draw: Empowered lands at the cursor, Supercharged flies past it; let go right on the flash for a faster next draw.
card.rmb: Hold to draw a Heavy Shot, let go to loose it: it knocks back and pins foes to walls.
card.e: Rain arrows on a curved wall at the cursor distance: damage, slow and a burn that blocks healing.
card.dash: Spirit Walk: a dodge roll, then {dash.time}s walking through rocks, trees and barriers.
card.passive: Hawk Sense: rivals under half health show through cover.
card.x: Starpiercer (level 6): your next {x.shots} shots need no draw and fly as big piercing arrows; the third can finish a foe.

weapons.longbow: Hold to draw: Empowered lands at the cursor, Supercharged flies past it; let go right on the flash for a faster next draw.

passive.name: Hawk Sense
passive.desc: Rivals under half health are seen through cover within {resource.sense_r}m.

dash.name: Spirit Walk
dash.desc: A quick dodge roll in the direction you move (or aim), then {dash.time}s as a spirit: rocks, trees, pillars and ability barriers don't stop you (cliffs and ledges still do); you move {tip.dash.pct_1%}% faster. Walking into something leaves a spirit orb there for {tip.dash.secs_1}s: anyone who touches it walks as a spirit too. Taking damage ends it. If it ends while you're inside something you are put back where you went in.

variants.hold: Heavy Shot: hold to draw a great needle on the bow (full at {rmb.pin.full}s; you move at {rmb.pin.hold_move%}% speed while you hold) and let go to loose it: {rmb.pin.dmg.0} -> {rmb.pin.dmg.1} damage, push {rmb.pin.push.0} -> {rmb.pin.push.1}, stops on the first foe; driven into a wall within {rmb.pin.range_rank3}m it hits again for about {rmb.pin.wall_mult} times the shot and stuns {rmb.pin.stun} (PINNED). A quick tap does nothing and costs nothing.

e.name: Hail Wall
e.desc: Lob a volley: {e.tell}s later arrows rain for {e.time}s on a curved wall {e.deg} degrees wide round you, at the cursor distance ({e.rmin}-{e.reach}m). Foes inside take {e.dmg} every {e.every}s, are slowed {e.slow%}% and burn blue (healing barely takes). A Heavy Shot that knocks a burning foe Cremates them: +{e.cremate} and a longer burn.

x.name: Starpiercer
x.desc: Tap: your next {x.shots} bow shots within {x.window}s need no draw. Each press nocks for {x.nock}s and looses a big arrow to {x.range}m that pierces every foe, knocks back and strips {x.shred} armor; the third hits harder and finishes a hunter it leaves under {x.execute%}% health.

rank3.sec: Heavy Shot flies {rmb.pin.range_rank3}m farther; a wall stun gives a dash charge
rank3.dash: Spirit Walk lasts {dash.time_rank3}s longer, is {dash.inside_boost%}% faster inside something (fading) and allies near you walk with you

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown {rmb.cooldown}s -> {cd3.sec}s, damage +{dmg3.sec%}%; flies {rmb.pin.range_rank3}m farther and a wall stun gives a dash charge.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown {e.cooldown}s -> {cd3.kin}s, damage +{dmg3.kin%}%; the Hail Wall is {tip.e.pct_1%}% wider.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge {cd.dash}s -> {cd3.dash}s per charge; Spirit Walk lasts {dash.time_rank3}s longer, is {dash.inside_boost%}% faster inside something (fading), allies within {dash.ally_r}m walk too.

tells.dash_spent: a green spirit shell over her while it lasts; dash pip dark
